edbDesc: An electrical resistance of exactly zero which occurs in certain materials below a characteristic temperature. Like ferromagnetism and atomic spectral lines, superconductivity is a quantum mechanical phenomenon. It is also characterized by a phenomenon called the Meissner effect, the ejection of any sufficiently weak magnetic field from the interior of the superconductor as it transitions into the superconducting state.
title: Superconductivity
